# UI Managers {#ui-managers}

![][image1]

## Alert Manager {#alert-manager}

![][image2]

The Alert Manager coordinates player-facing alerts within the Wrapper. It triggers native alert UI only for a small, well-defined set of conditions, while the Web UI handles most errors. Native alerts are reserved for website load failures, app-level connectivity issues on first launch (e.g., no internet), hard native errors that block usage, and maintenance events, such as maintenance mode or a required force-update to the latest version, so critical platform issues are surfaced clearly while routine errors remain within the web surface.

## Navigation Manager {#navigation-manager}

The Navigation Manager orchestrates all navigation within the Wrapper. Native routes are intentionally minimal, while most navigation is delegated to the Web App. It captures deep-link intents and forwards them through the Web Processor so in-web navigation occurs where it belongs. Native navigation is limited to the Force Update, Maintenance Mode, and No Network screens. If Unity-as-a-Library is integrated, the manager also coordinates seamless transitions between the Unity view and the WebView.
